record.field:
Soak
Solvent HF
Concentration 0.1
Balance DI water
Quartz parts are to be HF Cleaned in the first bath. Before soaking parts, use the teflon scraper to remove the bulk of the film from parts with thick brown deposition. Parts should be soaked for the minimum time required to remove all visual deposition from each part, including the holes. This may take as little as 1 minute, to as long as 15 minutes. As dep loosens, scrape dep from GDPs with teflon scraper or poly screen.
Monitor parts continuously until clean. When the HF soak is complete, transfer all parts to the 3rd bath, labeled "pre-rinse", for a minimun of 5 minutes. Insure you turn the circulation pump on to rinse the parts throughly, then off when complete. From here, transfer all parts to the 4th bath, labeled "final rinse" also for a minimun of 5 minutes. Insure Valve #4 is open, and the DI generation system is on and reading min 16 megohm. Remove the parts from the bath and rinse with the hand sprayer covering all suface areas, After rinsing, blow the parts off using CDA, until the parts are as visually dry as you can get them.
